plugins.dev_debug_hint: Attach your debugger to this local development process. Debugger access ends on Stop, reload or session end.
plugins.dev_hint: Choose a compiled plugin folder or a built SDK project. Commands, panels and rendering previews use temporary snapshots; installed packages stay unchanged.
plugins.dev_panel_hint: Run a command here or open its Development panel from Plugin panels. Reload closes the old panel; reopening needs fresh approval.
plugins.dev_consent: DEVELOPMENT SNAPSHOT. Reload cancels pending work and closes this panel. Nothing is installed. Session preferences are temporary and are deleted when the session ends. Fresh approval is required after reload.
plugins.recovered_hint: This version was recovered without activation. Enable it explicitly to use its contributions. Saved projects keep their original version references.
plugins.recovery_explanation: Recovery validates installed packages and rebuilds the inventory with every version disabled. Original inventory files, invalid package folders and unfinished installation files are preserved in a recovery archive. Saved panel data, projects and unrelated files stay in place. Unfinished installations are not installed. Recovery archives remain on disk for your review.
plugins.recovery_blocked: Safe backup is blocked by file access, file type or size. Restore readable regular inventory files and folder access, then review again. No inventory files have been replaced.
plugins.recovery_archive_count: Managed package or temporary entries to archive: {count}.
plugins.recovery_complete: Inventory recovered. Recovered versions were left disabled.
plugins.recovery_reason_invalid: Package failed validation; folder will be archived
plugins.pack_license_hint: Extension assets have their own licenses. Hover a sound name to read its license.
plugins.project_dependencies_hint: Review exact pack versions and replace references only when you choose. Replacements affect all uses and support Undo.
plugins.project_changed: The project changed. Review it and try again.
plugins.dependencies_replaced: Updated {count} clips. Use Undo to restore the original references.
plugins.no_project_dependencies: This project has no required pack assets.
plugins.invalid_project_dependencies: Some pack references are malformed. Review the affected clips in the inspector.
plugins.copied_presets_hint: {count} preset definitions were copied into the project. Their required assets are listed separately above.
plugins.owned_sounds_hint: {count} used sounds have independent library copies and do not require their original pack.
plugins.dependency_locked: A clip using this dependency is locked. Unlock it before replacing all uses.
plugins.builder_hint: Select appearance snapshots and files. Edit names, sample text and licensing before exporting.
plugins.builder_no_presets: Open a project to choose current styles, looks and motion, or add files below.
plugins.builder_original_license: Original pack license will be preserved.
plugins.builder_family_id: Font family ID (share an ID to group faces)
plugins.builder_license_hint: Provide redistribution and usage terms for each added file. Source pack licenses are preserved. Choose a new archive filename when exporting.
plugins.builder_font_hint: System fonts depend on availability on the other computer. Add and choose a font file here to bundle it.
plugins.replacement_parameters_hint: Matching numeric parameters are kept within the replacement ranges. New parameters use the replacement defaults.
plugins.migrate_hint: Review selected panel keys before copying. The source stays unchanged. Provider credentials and permissions are separate. Publisher names are unverified.
plugins.migrate_empty: No saved keys in this panel version.
plugins.migrate_done: Copied {count} preferences. Reopen the panel to use them.
plugins.browser_hint: Search enabled pack content and preview it on sample scenes. Apply uses your selected compatible clip; new titles and sounds insert at the playhead.
plugins.browser_applied: Applied to the project. Undo is available.
plugins.browser_open_project: Open a project to apply pack content.
plugins.author_preview_hint: These temporary samples never change your project. Enable build watching to preview valid edits automatically. Install a finished package before using it in a project.
plugins.storage_hint: Review unused sound previews before removing them. Active previews, installed packages, preferences and project-owned sound copies are retained. Older sound copies are kept because they may belong to saved projects.
plugins.preview_audio_failed: This sound preview could not be decoded.
plugins.author_hint: Tests use this temporary snapshot. Provider keys and export settings are not saved.
plugins.local_hint: Approve a trusted whisper-cli installation and set up only the models you need. Downloads require separate approval. Commands run locally and offer a reviewed SRT export.
plugins.permission_local_run: Run approved local speech tools on a user-picked source and review a transcript export
plugins.local_saved: Transcript saved as a new SRT file.
plugins.installed_hint: Manage extensions installed on this computer.
plugins.recovery_hint: Review damaged or interrupted plugin installations.
plugins.create_hint: Bundle sounds, fonts and creative presets into a reusable extension.
plugins.developer_hint: Enable SDK tools to load folders and test compiled development snapshots.
plugins.browser_empty: Install or enable a creative pack to browse its content here.
plugins.project_pack_count: Pack versions referenced by this project: {count}
plugins.project_pack_attention: Some required packs need attention. Review them before exporting.
settings.automatic_voice_order: Uses the first available configured engine. Current: {now}
plugins.extension_view_hint: Open a view to use its extension tools.
plugins.agent_command_detail: Version {version}. This trusted Node extension can access files, network connections and programs. Document changes join the current CraftAI edit and Undo. Completed files or external effects may remain after cancellation.
plugins.legacy_replacement_hint: A Node replacement is installed. This retired package is kept for its creative assets and saved preferences. Open the replacement to review its trust and activation controls.
plugins.legacy_migration_hint: This package uses a retired executable format. Its creative assets and saved preferences remain stored. Install a rebuilt Node extension to run its tools.
plugins.legacy_provider_hint: This provider format is retired. Install its rebuilt Node extension, then select its service here. Your previous choice and saved credentials remain stored.
plugins.select_plugin_hint: Choose an extension or creative pack to view its settings and tools.
plugins.empty_hint: Install a plugin package to add tools and creative assets to ClipCraft.
main.media_no_length: This file has no readable length: it may be damaged or its recording was interrupted.
main.media_no_streams: This file has no audio or video.
error-boundary.title: Something went wrong
error-boundary.message: ClipCraft stopped showing its window because of an error. Try again to go back to Home, where your project can be reopened from its autosave.
error-boundary.editor_message: Part of the editor stopped because of an error. Your project is still open and autosave keeps running. Try again to show the editor, or undo the last change if it caused the problem.
